During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="DB" /> a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] that lasted from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> scandalous rumors toppled the '''headlining star''' of the [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]],<ref name="DB" /> a prestigious<ref name="CSWE Galaxies">{{CSWECite|I|313|Galaxies Opera House}}</ref> [[Opera/Legends|opera]] house located in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of<ref name="SWCTP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CSWE Galaxies" /> [[Opula Deget/Legends|Opula Deget]], an up-and-coming<ref name="DB" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]] opera [[Musician/Legends|singer]], took great pleasure in ruining her rivals' careers by feeding such rumors to the media,<ref name="Starship">{{StarshipsVehiclesCite|11|Star Wars A&ndash;Z}}</ref> and backstage gossip<ref name="SWCTP" /> suspected that she was responsible for the headliner's fall from the limelight.<ref name="DB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Galaxies Opera House headliner was first referenced by the [[2005]] reference book ''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]'', written by [[Stephen J. Sansweet]] and [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="SWCTP" />
